categories.title: Foundations of embodied intelligence
categories.description: These works establish the idea that a general-purpose model can connect language and perception to actions executed by a real or simulated embodiment.

entries.title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
entries.note: A generalist policy trained across diverse robot datasets and designed for lightweight adaptation.

entries.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
entries.note: An openly released VLA that makes large-scale robot-policy research easier to reproduce.

entries.title: PaLM-E: An Embodied Multimodal Language Model
entries.note: Connects continuous sensor observations and language reasoning in one embodied model.

entries.title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
entries.note: A landmark demonstration of transferring web-scale visual-language knowledge into robot actions.

entries.title: RT-1: Robotics Transformer for Real-World Control at Scale
entries.note: Shows how a transformer policy can learn many real-world manipulation tasks from data.

categories.title: Learning policies and control
categories.description: This section covers the mechanisms that turn demonstrations, rewards, or imagined trajectories into reliable low-level behavior.

entries.title: TD-MPC2: Scalable, Robust World Models for Continuous Control
entries.note: Demonstrates a compact model-predictive approach across many continuous-control tasks.

entries.title: Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion
entries.note: Uses diffusion to model multimodal action distributions for visuomotor control.

entries.title: Learning Fine-Grained Bimanual Manipulation with Low-Cost Hardware
entries.note: Mobile ALOHA shows how whole-body demonstrations can make long-horizon bimanual skills accessible.

entries.title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
entries.note: DreamerV3 is a useful reference point for model-based control with a compact latent state.

entries.title: MimicGen: A Data Generation System for Scalable Robot Learning using Human Demonstrations
entries.note: Generates scalable imitation-learning data by composing human demonstrations in simulation.

categories.title: Language, planning, and tool use
categories.description: These papers ask how an agent turns a human goal into a sequence of grounded skills, tool calls, or recoverable actions.

entries.title: Code as Policies: Language Model Programs for Embodied Control
entries.note: Treats code generation as a bridge between natural-language goals and existing robot APIs.

entries.title: Inner Monologue: Embodied Reasoning through Planning with Language Models
entries.note: Feeds execution feedback back into language-model planning instead of assuming an open-loop plan.

entries.title: VoxPoser: Composable 3D Value Maps for Robotic Manipulation with Language Models
entries.note: Grounds language-generated programs in 3D value maps that a controller can execute.

entries.title: Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances
entries.note: SayCan separates what is useful for a task from what is physically feasible.

categories.title: Perception and world models
categories.description: An embodied agent needs a state estimate that is useful for action, not only a visually plausible description. This section follows the representations that make that estimate possible.

entries.title: FoundationPose: Unified 6D Pose Estimation and Tracking of Novel Objects
entries.note: Provides a foundation-model style approach to pose estimation for previously unseen objects.

entries.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
entries.note: Makes high-quality, view-consistent scene representations practical for interactive systems.

entries.title: Segment Anything
entries.note: A general segmentation model that has become a practical building block for robot scene understanding.

entries.title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
entries.note: The foundational neural scene representation behind much subsequent 3D reconstruction work.

categories.title: Simulation and environments
categories.description: Simulation is useful when it exposes assumptions, supports repeatable rollouts, and makes failure measurable. These environments provide the testing ground for that process.

entries.title: RoboCasa: Large-Scale Simulation of Everyday Tasks for Generalist Robots
entries.note: Brings household-scale task diversity to robot-learning simulation.

entries.title: Habitat 3.0: A Co-Habitat for Humans, Avatars and Robots
entries.note: Supports embodied navigation and social interaction in shared environments.

entries.title: ManiSkill2: A Unified Benchmark for Generalizable Manipulation Skills
entries.note: A broad manipulation suite with emphasis on visual generalization and physical variation.

entries.title: iGibson 2.0: Object-Centric Simulation for Robot Learning of Everyday Household Tasks
entries.note: Connects physically grounded household simulation with large-scale scene assets.

categories.title: Datasets and benchmarks
categories.description: Data and evaluation protocols determine what a system can learn and what a reported number means. The entries here are useful anchors for comparing embodiments, tasks, and generalization claims.

entries.title: DROID: A Large-Scale In-The-Wild Robot Manipulation Dataset
entries.note: A diverse real-world dataset designed to capture the variation that laboratory demonstrations often miss.

entries.title: LIBERO: Benchmarking Knowledge Transfer for Lifelong Robot Learning
entries.note: Tests whether a policy can retain and transfer knowledge across task sequences.

entries.title: Open X-Embodiment: Robotic Learning Datasets and RT-X Models
entries.note: Unifies data from many robots and tasks to study cross-embodiment learning.

entries.title: CALVIN: A Benchmark for Language-Conditioned Policy Learning for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation Tasks
entries.note: Measures language-conditioned, long-horizon manipulation with compositional task chains.

entries.title: Meta-World: A Benchmark and Evaluation for Multi-Task and Meta Reinforcement Learning
entries.note: A standard suite for multi-task and meta-learning in simulated manipulation.

entries.title: RLBench: The Robot Learning Benchmark & Learning Environment
entries.note: Provides a large set of language-described manipulation tasks in a common simulator.

categories.title: Safety, evaluation, and deployment
categories.description: Physical systems fail in ways that a single success rate cannot describe. These resources foreground constraints, risk, robustness, and the difference between a demonstration and a deployable system.

entries.title: Safety-Gymnasium: A Unified Safe Reinforcement Learning Benchmark
entries.note: A maintained benchmark for measuring reward and constraint satisfaction together.

entries.title: Train Offline, Test Online: A Real Robot Learning Benchmark
entries.note: Separates offline training from online evaluation on a real robot, making deployment gaps explicit.

entries.title: OpenAI Safety Gym
entries.note: Established a common language for constrained reinforcement-learning experiments.
